note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God and his hand are not pictured; Job is not portrayed as a biblical person but shown as an ordinary grey-haired man of today, as in Job 1; nothing violent is shown.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.

sections.meaning: Job will not be lectured as if he knew nothing: what his friends tell him is what everyone knows, and he is not beneath them.
ideas: Three friends lean over a grey-haired man at a kitchen table, fingers raised, lecturing; he sits upright with his arms folded and looks straight back at them, unimpressed
A grey-haired man rises from his chair to stand eye to eye with the friend who has been lecturing him
A grown man made to sit on a small child's chair while friends stand over him explaining
Two men of the same height stand face to face at eye level, neither looking down
A friend points up at the sun as if explaining it, while a grey-haired man shades his eyes, weary
An old man on a park bench listens with folded arms as three younger men lecture him
A grey-haired man sits in front of his own shelves of worn, well-read books while visitors lecture him
A man calmly finishes a puzzle his friends insisted only they could solve
A friend loudly reads out a road map to a man who has driven that road all his life
Three men talk over the head of a fourth, who sits with a patient, knowing half-smile

sections.meaning: The man who called on God and was answered has become a joke to his friend; the comfortable look down on anyone whose foot slips, while robbers and those who defy God live at ease.
ideas: A grey-haired man has slipped and fallen to one knee on a wet street while comfortable people behind a warm cafe window point at him and laugh
A grey-haired man sits alone on a bench while his friends stand a few steps away laughing at him, one pointing
A man kneeling to pray in a park while passers-by snicker
A man loses his footing on an icy step while a well-dressed man watches from a warm window, drink in hand, untroubled
Friends laugh together round a table while one man sits apart at the end, the butt of the joke
A burglar sleeps peacefully in a hammock in a sunny yard, surrounded by bags of stolen goods
A gated mansion behind high walls and security cameras, its owner lounging by the pool beside a stack of cash
A man on the deck of a luxury yacht in a calm sea, a briefcase of money beside him, perfectly at ease
A crooked dealer sleeps soundly in a huge bed while a storm passes harmlessly outside
A man clutches a thick roll of banknotes as if it were his protection, smiling

sections.meaning: Every creature, the birds, the earth and the fish, knows that Yahweh's hand has done this; the life of every living thing and the spirit of every person is in his hand.
ideas: A grandfather and his grandson lie on a hillside watching a vast flock of birds sweep across the sky
A girl crouches in a misty meadow face to face with a deer, both quite still, as if she were asking it something
A fisherman watches a great shoal of silver fish turn together in clear shallow water
A farmer kneels and lifts a handful of rich dark soil to look at it closely
A man and his horse stand side by side at a frosty dawn, the breath of both rising as clouds
A small child and a newborn lamb asleep side by side in the straw
Dolphins leap beside a small boat while a family watches in wonder
A newborn foal stands for the first time beside its mother
Commuters crossing a bridge on a cold morning, every person's breath rising in the air
A pair of swallows bring food to their nest under a barn roof while a boy watches

sections.meaning: Words must be tested as food is tasted; the old have gathered wisdom, but wisdom and might belong to God.
ideas: An old grandmother in her kitchen tastes the soup from a wooden spoon with her eyes closed, judging it with care
An old man with a deeply lined face listens closely to a young man, chin in hand, weighing every word
A wine maker holds a glass to the light and tastes, judging
An old woman cups her hand behind her ear to listen carefully
An old man at a window with a lifetime of books behind him, thinking
An old man looks up at a vast range of snow mountains at dawn, small beside them
Old hands steady a young person's hands on a carving tool
A grey-haired man stands beneath a vast starry sky
A tea taster sips from a row of small white cups
Waves breaking against an immense cliff

sections.meaning: What God tears down no one rebuilds; he holds back the waters and the land dries up, he lets them go and they overturn the earth.
ideas: A rowing boat lies stranded on the cracked dry bed of a vanished lake, an old jetty standing high and dry
A brown river in flood has burst its banks and pours across farmland, fences and a road under water
A roofless farmhouse in ruins, overgrown with weeds and young trees, never rebuilt
A heavy steel door shut fast in a concrete wall, with no handle on this side
Floodgates of a great dam thrown open, a torrent roaring out
A fishing village's boats lying on mud where the sea has drawn back
A bridge that the river has carried away, two broken ends facing each other
Dry riverbed with a single puddle, then rain clouds massing
A field split by a deep fresh gully cut by floodwater
Cracked earth under a white sky with a rusted water tank

sections.meaning: God strips the wise and the powerful of their standing: advisers, judges, kings, priests, elders and nobles alike.
ideas: A man in an expensive suit carries a cardboard box of his belongings out of a glass office tower, head down
A bronze statue of a statesman toppled from its pedestal lies in long grass in a city square
An empty leather chair at the head of a long boardroom table, the room deserted
A once-powerful man sits on a kerb in a rumpled suit, his tie loosened
A crown lying in the dust under rain
A gold chain of office left on an empty table
A distinguished elderly man at a podium, mouth open, lost for words
A judge's gavel lying on the floor of an empty courtroom
A grand mansion's gates chained shut, weeds growing through the drive
Pigeons settled on the head of a statue of a dignitary

sections.meaning: God brings what is hidden in deep darkness into the light, raises nations and brings them down, and takes the sense from leaders until they wander lost in the dark.
ideas: Sunlight strikes down into the bottom of a deep dark canyon, lighting what lay in shadow
A caver's headlamp lights up a vast hidden cavern
A once-busy modern city overgrown by forest, empty
A man in a dark suit and tie wanders alone in a vast trackless desert, no road or path, looking around lost
Men in suits grope with outstretched hands through thick dark fog
Footprints wandering in loops across desert sand
A compass needle spinning in a man's hand in the desert
A crowd walking out of a city along a long road
A man in a suit stumbles along a dark empty road at night
Dawn light reaching the floor of a deep forest

scenes.principle: Job is not beneath the friends who lecture him; what they tell him, everyone knows.
scenes.shows: A grey-haired man has risen from his chair to stand eye to eye with the younger friend lecturing him, unbowed.
scenes.prompt: In a plain living room of today, a grey-haired man in a simple shirt has risen from his chair and stands eye to eye with a younger friend who has been lecturing him with a raised finger. The two are exactly level, face to face, and the grey-haired man looks back steadily, unbowed. Two other friends sit watching on a sofa. Soft daylight.

scenes.principle: The righteous man has become a laughingstock; the untroubled have contempt for the one whose foot slips.
scenes.shows: A grey-haired man has slipped to his knees on a wet pavement while comfortable people in a warm cafe point and laugh.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy city pavement of today, a grey-haired man in a plain worn coat has slipped and fallen to one knee in a puddle, one hand on the wet ground. Just behind him, through the big bright window of a warm cafe, comfortable well-dressed people sitting dry with their coffee point at him and laugh. Grey daylight, the cafe glowing warm.

scenes.principle: The tents of destroyers are at ease, and those who provoke God are secure.
scenes.shows: A burglar sleeps peacefully in a hammock in a sunny yard, surrounded by bags of stolen goods.
scenes.prompt: A burglar in a dark hooded top sleeps peacefully in a hammock strung between two trees in a sunny, quiet back yard, his hands folded on his chest, completely at ease. On the grass round the hammock lie open bags spilling stolen things: jewellery, watches, handbags, a laptop, a television. Bright calm afternoon light.

scenes.principle: Ask the beasts and the birds of the sky, and they will teach you.
scenes.shows: A grandfather and his grandson lie on a seaside hill watching a vast flock of birds sweep across the sky.
scenes.prompt: On a grassy hillside by the sea in clear morning light, a grandfather and his young grandson lie on their backs side by side, looking up. Across the wide sky above them a vast flock of birds sweeps and turns together in a great flowing shape. The two are still, watching as if listening.

scenes.principle: In his hand is the life of every living thing and the spirit of all human flesh.
scenes.shows: A small child and a newborn lamb asleep side by side in the straw.
scenes.prompt: In a warm barn in soft morning light, a small child and a newborn lamb lie asleep side by side in clean golden straw, breathing gently, the child's hand resting on the lamb's woolly side. Peaceful and safe.

scenes.principle: The ear tests words as the palate tastes food; among the aged is wisdom.
scenes.shows: An old man with a lined face listens to a young man, chin in hand, weighing every word.
scenes.prompt: In a quiet room of today, an old man with a deeply lined face and white hair sits listening closely to a young man who is talking to him. The old man's chin rests on his hand and his eyes are narrowed, weighing every word before he accepts it. Soft daylight.

scenes.principle: He holds back the waters, and they dry up.
scenes.shows: A rowing boat stranded on the cracked bed of a lake that has dried up, its jetty high and dry.
scenes.prompt: A small wooden rowing boat lies stranded on the cracked, dried-out bed of a lake whose water has completely vanished. A long wooden jetty stands high and dry above the cracked mud, and the old waterline shows as a pale band on the hills all round. Hard white daylight.

scenes.principle: He sends the waters out, and they overturn the earth.
scenes.shows: A brown river in flood pours across farmland, fences and a road under water.
scenes.prompt: A great brown river in flood has burst its banks and is pouring across farmland. Fences, a road and the tops of hedges are under the rushing water, and a small farm building stands knee-deep in the torrent. Heavy grey sky, wide view.

scenes.shows: A man in an expensive suit carries a cardboard box of his things out of a glass office tower, head down.
scenes.prompt: A man in an expensive dark suit walks out through the glass doors of a tall gleaming office tower carrying a cardboard box of his belongings: a desk lamp, framed photos, a plant. His head is down and his tie is loosened. Daylight on the glass.

scenes.principle: He overthrows the long-established and pours out contempt on nobles.
scenes.shows: A bronze statue of a statesman lies toppled in the long grass below its empty pedestal, pigeons on it.
scenes.prompt: In a city square, a large bronze statue of a statesman in a suit has been toppled from its tall stone pedestal and lies on its side in the long uncut grass. The empty pedestal stands above it. Pigeons perch on the fallen statue. Overcast daylight.

scenes.principle: He uncovers deep things out of darkness and brings the shadow of death out to the light.
scenes.shows: A shaft of sunlight strikes down to the floor of a deep, dark canyon.
scenes.prompt: Looking down into a deep, narrow canyon that has been in darkness, a shaft of bright sunlight now strikes straight down to the very bottom, lighting up the hidden floor, a stream and the rocks that lay in shadow. The rest of the canyon walls are still dark.

scenes.principle: He takes away the sense of the chiefs and makes them wander in a waste with no way.
scenes.shows: A man in a business suit stands lost in a trackless desert, his wandering footprints behind him.
scenes.prompt: In a vast empty sand desert with no road, no track and no landmark in any direction, a man in a dark business suit and tie wanders alone, turning to look about him, lost. His wandering footprints trail behind him in a curve. Hazy, featureless sky.
